Yes, you can! Since the snapped main stem qualifies as damage on arrival (DOA), you're covered—but you needed to report it within **48 hours** of delivery, and you're now at **3 days**, so you've missed that window.

However, the good news is that snapped stems are also covered under our **30-day Plant Care Guarantee** (or **90 days** if you're a Leafy Plus member). You can claim through "My Orders" with at least **two photos** (whole plant + close-up of the damage), and a Plant Care Specialist will review within **2 business days**. If approved, we'll send you a free replacement of the same plant—no need to send the damaged one back.

Would you like help with anything else, or do you have your order number handy?
